_comment: Pinned rival-tool versions for docs/RESULTS.md. compare_tools.py never reads
PATH - it resolves each tool into .tools/<name>-<version>/ and verifies sha256
before use. Upgrading a rival is a reviewable PR that visibly moves numbers.
cdxgen has no meaningful standalone binary release; `npx --yes
@cyclonedx/cdxgen@<exact version>` pins it exactly and npm's own registry
integrity covers the download, so it carries no sha256 here.

sbom-tool.sha256_source: the release's own linux-x64-manifest.spdx.json, not a separate checksums file - sbom-tool vouching for itself
